meta.source: masslak brand v2 (navy, blue, destination green)

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Filled buttons, links, active navigation, selected seats, progress and the second line of display headlines. Reads on surface and surface-dim (5.7:1 or more light, 10.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fills.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Tonal buttons, active navigation pill, info chips and banners, selected filters.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-container and primary-soft (11.4:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Information banner ground and hover tint on interactive rows.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Amber for money and waiting: pending payments, fares due, boarding soon. Reads on surface (5.9:1).

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary fills.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Pending and warning chips, money buttons.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-container and secondary-soft.

tokens.name: secondary-soft
tokens.usage: Warning banner ground.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Navy accent for live tracking, in-progress trips and neutral emphasis.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tertiary fills.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: In-progress badges and neutral highlighted chips.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tertiary-container and tertiary-soft.

tokens.name: tertiary-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet navy panel ground.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed, valid and paid states; the destination green of the identity. Reads on surface (5.3:1 light, 10.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text and icons on success fills.

tokens.name: success-container
tokens.usage: Confirmed and valid chips, success banners, valid scan results.

tokens.name: on-success-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on success-container and success-soft (10.9:1 light, 7.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success banner ground.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text, destructive actions and invalid field outlines (6.5:1 light, 10.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text on error fills.

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Error banners, cancelled and rejected chips.

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on error-container (7.2:1 both themes).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs, app bars and table bodies.

tokens.name: surface-dim
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Table headers, quiet panels, hover rows.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Filled text fields, bottom navigation bar, hover fills.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Progress tracks, taken seats, pressed states.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Skeleton loaders and the deepest nested container.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and display headlines on every surface token (16:1 light, 15:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and inactive icons on every surface token (6.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Text-field and outlined-button borders and other control edges that must reach 3:1 (4.6:1 on surface).

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Hairline card and cell borders. Decorative only, never the only edge of an input.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and sections.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbars and tooltips.

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-surface (13.9:1).

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Action text inside a snackbar.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal dialogs and drawers, at 32 percent opacity.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Identity navy: the logo square, app icons, the dark ticket band, footers and print.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Identity blue: the logo route on navy (4.2:1 on brand-navy) and its origin stop on white. Decorative; UI uses primary.

tokens.name: brand-blue-soft
tokens.usage: Identity light blue: the origin stop of the logo on navy (7.4:1 on brand-navy). Decorative only.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: Identity green, the destination stop of the logo, inspired by the Syrian flag green. Decorative; UI uses success.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Loyalty tiers and premium fare brands only, as decoration.

tokens.name: brand-gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold when read as text: loyalty tier labels (6.4:1 light, 9.5:1 dark).

families.display: "Readex Pro", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Tahoma, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The Masslak wordmark only: مســلك and masslak, in Hayyakum Allah Bold. Never for headings or body text.

styles.name: display-large
styles.usage: Marketing hero on the public website only.

styles.name: display-small
styles.usage: Large numerals: wallet balance, boarding countdown.

styles.name: headline-medium
styles.usage: Page titles on mobile, dialog heroes.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: Card titles, app bar titles, departure times on trip cards.

styles.name: title-medium
styles.usage: List item titles, table group titles.

styles.name: body-large
styles.usage: Default reading text in apps and forms.
styles.sample: يمكنك إلغاء الحجز حتى ساعتين قبل موعد الانطلاق.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Default text in web portals, tables and cards.

styles.name: data-code
styles.usage: Booking references, ticket numbers, plate numbers, trip numbers.

styles.name: data-large
styles.usage: The booking reference on the ticket and the boarding screen.

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: space-16

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Progress bars, tooltips, focus outline corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, status badges, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, scan results, the logo square at 64px.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, tickets, hero cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, badges dots, avatars and the navigation pill.
